test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Jai, Pia, Era, Ram and Shubh are sitting in a straight line facing north. Jai is sitting second to the left of Shubh. Shubh is sitting to the immediate right of Era. Pia is sitting at the extreme right end. Ram is sitting to the immediate right of Shubh. Who among the following is sitting at the extreme left end?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Number of people in a row = 5, namely Jai, Pia, Era, Ram and Shubh.
 
• They are facing the North direction.

**To find: **The name of the person sitting at extreme left end.

**Explanation:**

 
• Pia is sitting at the extreme right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60ce6f24ccdbf9267ff5b7c4e0a6d994fb75da86904e19bb9c390bee11b4ec9f.png] 

 
• Shubh is sitting to the immediate right of Era.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba095ec7b724c0febfb646ae2e8b31dad235f455858f5a11a73802a66d668d1d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891aad8609c5cb4f08765ec750b37362e62003ada457ddd63c84e4fed0d7e948.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0257111148d25a00354f4e12ea1f35b23e10ee662a140032ff5160c4280ba3e7.png] 

Jai is sitting second to the left of Shubh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9f0c92cf87ac7eb57c447af6fec12b35cee87039476a4185c47067c4fb9bdce.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccad02ae07098e6d6601e9fc2555e1d68c69d99d7573e1bee19b0ff20ea4675f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fb3fc726098d35a5e233492693b0b413bd17dbdc0ea54dddeb3b1077ee03581.png] 

 
• Case 1 gets eliminated because Jai cannot be placed second to the left of Shubh.
 
• Ram is sitting to the immediate right of Shubh. 

​Only case 2 can place Ram as per the given condition. So, case 3 gets eliminated.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dd09ef27958a8586e2d685d933151b822111c3755373397a84edb63f9a3eb30.png] 

 
• So, **Jai is sitting at the extreme left end.**
 
• Hence, **Jai **is the ***correct answer.***

42:T
